failed_attempt: First fixture tried to redeliver an already acknowledged, retired sender outbox after validating duplicate reception. SDK returned Durable(Protocol(Retired)). Corrected duplicate-case fixture reads original sender status and compares the duplicate ACK with the already authenticated baseline. scope: Actual installed Chrome Worker receive path using a session descriptor opened before the roster update, real native ciphertext, original required signed witness and IndexedDB/Web Locks/OPFS. Native counterpart shares the Rust engine and loopback transport. Not automatic distribution, independent implementation, deployment, device coverage, representative performance, PCS or full-release qualification.
trace_policy: Complete public operation results, input ciphertext, peer traffic and witness metadata are archived. Repetitive raw witness/native traces remain in closed task-local runs with FULL_RAW_TRACE_MANIFEST.json. Private keys, journal stores and browser profiles are excluded.
